issues.issue: Request body is logged in plaintext when logBody is enabled, potentially exposing sensitive data (passwords, tokens, PII) in logcat.
issues.fix: Avoid logging request bodies by default, or redact sensitive fields before logging. Consider making logBody false in production builds.

issues.issue: Response body is logged in plaintext when logBody is enabled, potentially exposing sensitive data (tokens, PII, API responses) in logcat.
issues.fix: Avoid logging response bodies by default, or redact sensitive fields before logging. Consider making logBody false in production builds.

issues.issue: Logging request headers (even redacted) may leak non-sensitive header names and values that could aid attackers in reconnaissance.
issues.fix: Consider logging only essential headers or disable header logging in production.

issues.issue: Logging response headers may expose server information or internal details that could aid attackers.
issues.fix: Consider logging only essential headers or disable header logging in production.
